literalAdjudication.scenario: Only ux-024: Given taskbar menu has focus; Tab traversal then Escape; focus follows menu order and returns to original eligible target. A genuine current observed-window taskbar menu is within that literal case. Read-only menu content does not invalidate a focus case.
literalAdjudication.requirement: The EARS clause says a shell popup, without restricting popup mode. A pass for the named taskbar-menu scenario does not demonstrate every other reachable shell-popup focus policy. The single scenario count is not a logical expansion of its evidence scope.
literalAdjudication.conditionalScenarioDisposition: accepted only after the actual protected native pass/normal cleanup and independent current-source phase/pixel/original-oracle review have no missing named-case observations
literalAdjudication.conditionalWholeRequirementDisposition: Keep requirementAccepted=false/status=partial for this bounded taskbar-only adjudication. A later independent whole-clause review may use coherent current evidence for remaining popup modes; this guide does not require unrelated window actions/SystemMenu implementation/AT/release completion before accepting ux-024.

nativeReviewChecklist: Actual current R5 Backend/Elm and compiled owner/controller/bar/popup correspond to this packet; no old fixture-only HTML or constructor-only observation.
Real owned mapped window produces the current taskbar group and the exact keyboard context route opens its genuine MenuBridge popup.
Actual physical keyboard focus is in the current popup; Tab forward/wrap and Shift-Tab reverse follow declared Close/Refresh order, skip disabled facts and stay in the menu.

Escape dismisses; a fresh correlated WindowRead verifies the same owner and complete handle fingerprint, current presentation and still-eligible origin; actual DOM/physical focus returns once. Repeated Escape/reopen sequence does not replay a stale return.
All nine fixed transactions completed without pointer input or retry, within the original28+2 and16-frame ceiling; actual phase evidence and PNGs are independently inspected.
Actual owner Closed/Retired/whole normal cleanup and global restoration are present; no timeout/force/unknown cleanup.
Any missing observation yields partial/unknown/changes-required. No future pass or acceptance is presumed.

exactOriginalInputSteps: Given a taskbar menu has focus, use Tab and Shift-Tab to traverse its documented eligible controls.
Continue traversal at both endpoints and remain within the current menu; disabled rows do not become actionable.
Press Escape to dismiss and restore the original eligible focus target.
